A2.definition: ((Mxx-Myy)^2+4*Mxy^2)/trace(M)^2; exact rational via scaled axial centered coordinates

P_edge.definition: number of occupied-to-empty nearest-neighbor directed cut edges

boundary_squared_radius_dispersion.definition: CV^2 of q_i=Q(N*b_i-S)/N^2 over occupied boundary sites; exact rational; 0 if all q_i=0

six_direction_boundary_imbalance.definition: 6*sum_k c_k^2/(sum_k c_k)^2 - 1 for exposed-edge direction counts c_k; exact rational

primary_objective.equivalent_fast_form: G(C)=N*sum_{x in C} Q(x)-Q(sum_{x in C} x)
move_ranking: frozen tie-break only among equal best G
primary_objective.replacement_delta: For d=v-u and S=sum_C x: DeltaG=N*(Q(v)-Q(u))-[L(S,d)+Q(d)], where L((a,b),(c,d))=2ac+ad+bc+2bd=2<B(S,d)>.

tie_breaks.rule: Among equal-best-G candidate states choose lexicographically smallest translation+D6 canonical state encoding; then smallest canonicalized (u,v) move key.
Among equal-best-G candidate states choose lexicographically largest translation+D6 canonical state encoding; then largest canonicalized (u,v) move key.
Among equal-best-G moves choose lexicographically smallest (u,v) after translation-normalizing the current orientation only; candidate canonical shape is not used for the first tie.
